skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.farmer_ma: Increases credits earned when delivering crops/seeds/produce by 1% per level.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.farmer_fi: Farmer EXP gain increases by 1% per level. Also adds a 1.5% chance per level, capped at 45%, to obtain extra produce when harvesting crops.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.farmer_se: When Human Tractor replants crops, adds a 1.5% chance per level, capped at 45%, to avoid consuming seeds.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.farmer_ca: Further increases credits earned when delivering crops/seeds/produce by 1% per level.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.farmer_so: Crops within 12m of you have a 1.25% chance per level, capped at 40%, to receive extra growth ticks.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.farmer_bo: [Unlocks at Lv.25] Harvesting crops has an 8% + 5% per level chance, capped at 60%, to grow nearby crops. Level increases the growth radius.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.farmer_su: [Unlocks at Lv.50] Craft and place a Scarecrow on your land. It prevents monster spawns nearby, and level increases the prevention radius.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.farmer_fi: [Unlocks at Lv.75] Harvesting mature crops chain-harvests connected matching crops, up to 45 total, sends drops to your inventory, and replants automatically. Replanted farmland becomes fertile for 20s and grows crops once per second. Level increases the chain-harvest count.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.farmer_ea: [Unlocks at Lv.100] Allows nearby crops to grow and restores moisture to nearby farmland. Harvesting has a 3% + 2% per level chance to create '+' grade produce, which can sell for up to 2x credits. Level increases radius and '+' grade chance.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.fisher_ma: Increases credits earned when delivering fish and aquatic products by 1% per level.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.fisher_li: Fisher EXP gain increases by 1% per level. Also provides a 1.5% chance per level, capped at 45%, to refund fishing rod durability loss.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.fisher_lu: Reduces fishing bite wait by up to 10 ticks based on level. Hotspots reduce it by another 10 ticks, and fishery zones by another 18 ticks.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.fisher_ne: Further increases credits earned when delivering fish and aquatic products by 1% per level.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.fisher_cu: Adds a 1.5% chance per level, capped at 45%, to catch one extra copy of the reward.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.fisher_do: [Unlocks at Lv.25] Senses 'Hotspots' in nearby waters that rotate positions over time. Fishing at a hotspot reduces bite wait by another 10 ticks and emits bubble/glow particles. Level increases search radius, duration, and display radius.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.fisher_ti: [Unlocks at Lv.50] Successful fishing has a 25% + 5% per level chance, capped at 75%, to pull up extra loot. Extra rewards include fish, treasure, or junk, with higher levels improving rare reward odds.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.fisher_ca: [Unlocks at Lv.75] Successful fishing grants 10% + 4% per level flow gauge, capped at 50%. At 100%, use the assigned job skill key to create a fishery zone lasting 60s + 12s per level, capped at 180s. Fishing inside reduces bite wait by another 18 ticks.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.fisher_tr: [Unlocks at Lv.100] Successful fishing has a 6% + 5.8% per level chance, capped at 35%, to reel in a Deep Sea Crate. Higher levels improve the odds of better wood/stone/iron/diamond crate tiers, which open into 1-3 rewards.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.miner_mar: Miner delivery price increases by 1% per level.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.miner_tun: Miner EXP gain increases by 1% per level. Mining speed also increases by 2% per level, capped at 60%, with Haste refreshed as a support effect at higher levels.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.miner_ore: Mining ore gains an extra-drop chance of 8% plus 1.5% per level, capped at 60%.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.miner_vei: Mining rock blocks has a 0.5% chance per level, capped at 5%, to drop a hidden random ore.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.miner_car: Miner delivery price increases by another 1% per level.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.miner_fau: Mining gains a durability refund chance of 10% plus 1.5% per level, capped at 60%.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.miner_sto: Mouse 5 toggles chain mining. Mining also breaks nearby matching ore or rock blocks; the cap scales by level up to 6 ore blocks or 4 rock blocks.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.miner_dee: Your long-honed mining instinct discovers hidden ore-born gems. Mining ores has a very rare chance to drop Enhancement Gems, from cracked to perfect. Higher grades add fixed enhancement success chance; perfect gems guarantee success.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.miner_eye: Mouse 4 toggles ore sight. It outlines ores through walls within 8 + level*2 blocks, capped at 28 blocks. While active it drains 5% max health per second, blocks healing, and shuts off at low health.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.cook_mark: Chef delivery price increases by 1% per level.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.cook_prep: Chef EXP gain increases by 1% per level.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.cook_seas: Cooking gains a 1.5% chance per level, capped at 45%, to yield one extra portion.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.cook_hear: Increases cooked food nutrition by 5% per level, capped at 50%. Cooking has a 15% + 5% per level chance, capped at 65%, to create a masterpiece food that grants a random combat buff.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.cook_kitc: Chef delivery price increases by another 1% per level.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.cook_tast: Cooking has a 1.5% chance per level, capped at 45%, to refund consumed ingredients.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.cook_warm: Eating chef's food to full hunger grants one random meal buff (Speed, Haste, Regen, Resistance) for 60s per level, capped at 10 minutes. The amplifier improves at levels 4, 7, and 10.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.hunter_ma: Read the market as a hunter. Monster loot delivery price increases by 1% per level.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.hunter_hu: Hunter EXP gain increases by 1% per level. Basic drops from monsters and animals also gain a 1.5% chance per level, capped at 45%, to increase by one.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.hunter_we: Fine-tune weapon actions to dismantle targets. Yields a 1.25% chance per level, capped at 35%, to copy all drops from monsters and animals.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.hunter_tr: Accurately assess target values. Credits gained from killing monsters and animals increase by 2% per level, capped at 60%, and delivery price also increases by 1% per level.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.hunter_vi: Read enemy movement to support hunter special proc chances. Current value is 1% per level.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.hunter_qu: Use job skill key 1 to toggle tracking, consuming hunger over time. While active, monsters and animals within 12+level*3m, capped at 42m, are highlighted with Glowing outlines and particles. Ends when food is too low or after 20s+7s per level, capped at 90s. Kills grant Speed I for 4s+level*2s.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.hunter_st: Attacks have a 10%+level*5% chance to inflict [Bleeding] status. Bleeding targets take 1+level*0.5 damage every 2s and move slower. Kills have a 10% + special-proc bonus/2 + level*5% chance, capped at 60%, to grant Strength I for 3s+level*2s, capped at 23s. (Boss: 50% dmg, PvP: 25% dmg, refreshes on hit)
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.hunter_wi: Use job skill key 2 to mark a target highlighted by Tracker's Instincts. Marked targets take 10%+5% per level increased damage, capped at 60%, yield 2x loot and credits on death, and grant Speed II and Haste II to the slayer. Regular kills also grant Resistance I for 5s+level*3s.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.hunter_ap: While Tracker's Instincts is active, hitting the randomized 3D weakpoint direction deals massive critical damage (1.4+level*0.12x), heals up to 1% max health per level capped at 10%, and grants Speed III. Weakpoints reroll every 3 seconds.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.cook_chef: Cooked food in inventory gains 1 ageing level every 60 seconds, up to the skill level. Eating aged food increases nutrition by 8% per ageing level, capped at 80%.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.cook_mast: Use Mouse 4 to open the Master Recipe GUI. Configures 1-2 special buffs (Death Defy, Boss Slayer +20%, Golden Luck, Max Health, Immunity, Steel Guard -30%) onto cooked items.
skill_node.nogeon_economy_land.engineer_: Engineer delivery price increases by 1% per level.
Engineer job EXP gain increases by 1.5% per level.
Engineer activity special event trigger chance increases by 1.5% per level.
Engineer delivery price increases by another 1% per level.
Engineer activity special event trigger chance increases by another 1.5% per level.

[Unlocks at Lv.25] Pressing Mouse 5 opens the Mechanical Compression GUI, allowing you to compress blocks (e.g., 64 cobblestones) to roll for Apotheosis and Enhancement gems. Gem tier probabilities scale with the skill level.

[Unlocks at Lv.50] Maximizes efficiency near Create-family machines inside industrial land where you can build. Grants Haste II and Speed I (Haste III and Speed II at level 5+), restores hunger and thirst every 2 seconds by chance based on skill level, and repairs held wrench/pickaxe durability every second.

[Unlocks at Lv.75] Optimizes manufacturing processes. Crafting Create machine parts or TACZ ammunition has a 10% chance per level to refund a random ingredient, and firing TACZ guns has a 3% chance per level to conserve ammunition. While the drone is active, ammo save chance gains another +30%.

[Unlocks at Lv.100] Toggles the supportive Auto Scrap Drone with Mouse 4. It does not consume hunger, but drone functions require charge. Near industrial Create machines it charges +2% every 0.5s; right-click with a wrench for +20%, feed a cogwheel for +50%, or Shift+right-click the drone to open the deconstruction/power GUI. The drone provides support fire, absorption shield refill, nanite equipment repair and healing, item vacuum, fall safety, firearm assist, and scrap salvage credits that scale with engineer level and drone upgrades.

help.nogeon_economy_land.start.1: Open the wallet with the Economy Ledger or the configured economy key.
help.nogeon_economy_land.start.2: Use the wallet buttons for skills, land, auction, trade, and this guide.
help.nogeon_economy_land.start.3: Credits are shared by every economy feature.
help.nogeon_economy_land.start.4: NPCs are the main way to buy, deliver, gamble, use gacha, and enhance gear.
help.nogeon_economy_land.start.5: Merchant prices and delivery values can change each in-game day.
help.nogeon_economy_land.jobs.1: Jobs: farmer, fisher, miner, cook, hunter, and engineer.
help.nogeon_economy_land.jobs.2: Job actions give EXP, levels, and skill points.
help.nogeon_economy_land.jobs.3: Skills improve delivery prices, EXP gain, and job-specific effects.
help.nogeon_economy_land.jobs.4: Delivery bonuses only apply to the matching job's delivery NPC.
help.nogeon_economy_land.jobs.5: Hunter gains EXP and credits from monster kills.
help.nogeon_economy_land.traders.1: Merchant NPCs sell supplies and buy delivery items.
help.nogeon_economy_land.traders.2: Shop stock has daily purchase limits.
help.nogeon_economy_land.traders.3: Items bought from shops cannot be auctioned.
help.nogeon_economy_land.traders.4: Lottery, gambler, gacha, smith, land, and auction NPCs open special screens.
help.nogeon_economy_land.traders.5: Admin shift-click opens NPC shop editing.
help.nogeon_economy_land.systems.1: Land can store homes and protect building or interaction permissions.
help.nogeon_economy_land.systems.2: Player trade can exchange items, credits, and land.
help.nogeon_economy_land.systems.3: Trades are logged and cancel safely if a player disconnects.
help.nogeon_economy_land.systems.4: Blacksmith enhancement works on weapons, armor, guns, and compatible gear.
help.nogeon_economy_land.systems.5: High enhancement levels greatly increase power but carry higher risk.

reforge.desc.mining_speed: Increases mining speed when breaking blocks.
reforge.desc.durability_thrift: Gives a chance to not consume durability when mining.
reforge.desc.double_drop: Gives a chance to double the drops when breaking blocks.
reforge.desc.mineral_finder: Gives a chance to find bonus credits when mining ores.
reforge.desc.gemstone_hunter: Gives a chance to drop extra gems and earn credits when mining gemstones.
reforge.desc.treasure_digger: Gives a chance to dig up hidden treasure (credits or materials) in dirt/sand.
reforge.desc.clay_master: Drops extra clay balls and grants Speed II when mining clay.
reforge.desc.lumberjack: Gives a chance to drop extra logs when chopping logs.
reforge.desc.tree_sap: Gives a chance to gain beneficial buffs when chopping logs.
reforge.desc.bountiful_harvest: Doubles crop harvest drops and grants agriculture credits.
reforge.desc.replanting: Automatically replants crops from seed in your inventory upon harvesting.
gui.nogeon_economy_land.auction_buy_ques: Are you sure you want to purchase this item?
gui.nogeon_economy_land.auction_cancel_q: Are you sure you want to cancel this listing?
reforge.desc.spell_power: Increases the damage and power of magic spells.
reforge.desc.cast_time_reduction: Reduces the time required to cast spells.
reforge.desc.fishing_speed: Reduces the wait time for a fish to bite the hook.
reforge.desc.double_catch: Provides a chance to catch an extra copy of the fish.
reforge.desc.rare_fish_finder: Increases the chance of catching higher-tier rare fish.
reforge.desc.treasure_hunter: Increases the chance of reeling in treasure instead of fish.
reforge.desc.spell_crit_chance: Increases the chance of spells dealing critical damage.
reforge.desc.mana_cost: Reduces the mana cost when casting spells.
